name: Voxel Hashing
definition: A GPU-side spatial hash table implementation for storing active TSDF voxel blocks, enabling fast random access and parallel block processing.
summary: Voxel Hashing is a sparse volumetric data structure that enables real-time 3D reconstruction by using a hash table for constant-time access to voxel blocks, avoiding the memory waste of fixed grids and the traversal overhead of octrees.
